# The Dance Exclusive

> Commercial and street dance for children and adults across Essex, UK.

## Public information
- [Find a class](https://www.thedanceexclusive.co.uk/classes): current classes, times, audiences, venues, prices and availability.
- [Locations](https://www.thedanceexclusive.co.uk/venues): local venues and their current classes.
- [Coaches](https://www.thedanceexclusive.co.uk/team): published coach profiles and classes.
- [Camps and workshops](https://www.thedanceexclusive.co.uk/events): current and upcoming events.
- [Contact](https://www.thedanceexclusive.co.uk/contact): contact the school.
- [Sitemap](https://www.thedanceexclusive.co.uk/sitemap.xml): current public page URLs.

Prices and availability can change. Each class page reads the booking system; booking confirms current eligibility, availability and any applicable discounts.
